scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm --filter backend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && pnpm --filter backend format && pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter frontend format:check && pnpm --filter backend format:check && pnpm --filter @transcendence/shared format:check
